description: This file implements core functions for a string component object used within a BSP (Board Support Package) engine. It defines creation, initialization, and removal of the component object, including setting up function pointers for various read/write operations and managing internal storage.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BspTemplateArchiveCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BSP template archive component object, setting up function pointers for various read/write operations, and allocates internal storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspTemplateArchiveCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified archive component object, releasing its internal storage and freeing memory.
